question: Does unusually one-sided aggressive flow that fails to push the candle close in its own direction lead to a tradable move in the opposing direction?
source: exp-btcusdtp-genuine-flow-coverage-20260907-v34; all 24 original Binance USD-M BTCUSDT 5m files, 2023 and 2024.
signal: Absolute buy-minus-sell taker quote volume divided by total quote volume exceeds the 90th percentile of the preceding 288 bars. Close above open with net aggressive selling gives a long; close below open with net aggressive buying gives a short.
fills: Next 5m open; exit 5 or 15 minutes after entry; same signals with minimum 15-minute separation. Same seeded random nonsignal, same side and same 4h block/lagged volatility bin as exp-intraday-hour-sweep-20261114-v1. No tuning.
costs: 5bp each side, regular-tier OKX fee assumption applied to Binance prices. No spread, slippage, lot rounding or funding. Percent return on notional; no account projection.
